You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Joshua Santiago. Pharmacist. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Carpenter's square, Grandma's Tin Cup, Search locket, Field suture kit, Beat-up Paperback. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit

📓 Journal: Food won't come to Haven. Walk past the treeline — learn what grows out there, bring it back, and get it named at camp.
